Replace ActiveRideView._MapPlaceholder with active-ride map widget

authoritySplit.neverInvert: Do not infer ride state from RTDB presence; do not treat RTDB as fare/assignment authority

showLiveDriverMarkerWhen: ActiveRidePhase is active (or equivalent non-terminal UI phase)
ride.state in DRIVER_ASSIGNED | DRIVER_EN_ROUTE | DRIVER_ARRIVED | RIDE_STARTED
stateGating.emptyLatestAfterGrant: Valid — show waiting/no-fix chrome; do not fabricate coordinates
alignWith: isActiveRidePollingState (subset overlap; stop live map at COMPLETED even if poll continues)
stateGating.note: isActiveRidePollingState includes RIDE_COMPLETED for close UX; live location listener MUST stop at COMPLETED because cleanupTripLocationOnTerminal clears RTDB then.

rtdbListenerLifecycle.recommendedShape: AutoDispose family provider keyed by rideId (mirror DriverLocationSession discipline)
rtdbListenerLifecycle.auth: Reuse existing Firebase Auth session; App Check already in app — verify RTDB App Check policy if enabled on project
rtdbListenerLifecycle.parse: Validate TripLocationLatest fields; reject non-finite lat/lng; ignore malformed snapshots

rtdbListenerLifecycle.permissionDenied: Treat as stopped/unavailable — expected after ACL revoke; do not crash

staleLocationBehavior.rationale: Publisher heartbeat ~10s when fix fresh (12s freshness); background stops GPS+publish → passenger must surface staleness rather than animate
ux: Stale: dimmed marker + 'Location updating…' / last-updated relative copy (no precise coords in logs)
Missing: waiting shell; keep pickup/dest if available
Never invent heading motion when stale
staleLocationBehavior.seqMonotonicity: Prefer higher locationSeq; ignore older seq if out-of-order delivery observed

riskRegister.detail: Best-effort RTDB projection can diverge from durable accept — passenger UX must tolerate gaps (not a security issue).
Security rules already enforce passenger-only read via ACL; MAP-2 adds no write surface.
Insertion point is ActiveRide _MapPlaceholder — MAP-1 request map remains isolated.
New firebase_database dependency + App Check/RTDB policy must be verified on staging during physical proof.
Dual observation (HTTP state + RTDB location) is intentional and already foreshadowed by L2/MAP-1 audits.
onDriverOffline unwired is a known L2 gap; stale UX covers passenger impact for MAP-2A.
